_description: Held-out forms generality validation for the form-field resolvers (Increments A+D). Single-doc: IRS Schedule 8812 (Credits for Qualifying Children and Other Dependents, 2025). SAFETY-framed: does the multiply resolver stay CONSERVATIVE on a form it was NOT built on (no wrong-route, no fabrication, refusal_cf holds)? Schedule 8812 uses LINE-REFERENCE multiply lines ('Multiply line 4 by $2,200', content on the referenced line) — the more common IRS style, vs the W-4's INLINED style the resolver was built on.
_labelling_rule: ANS = fact verbatim in Schedule 8812; REF = fact NOT on Schedule 8812 (must refuse). Note: the multiply-line ANS (f8812-01/02) are EXPECTED to safe-refuse (the documented benefit-generality boundary) — the gate is that they refuse SAFELY, never fabricate $2,200/$500, and never wrong-route.
_source_note: IRS Schedule 8812 (f1040s8.pdf), public-domain US-gov (17 USC 105). Source PDF LOCAL in ~/corpus-drop/heldout/ (only the query set + baseline ship). Held-out generality test of the form-field resolvers; see realworld_corpora_2026_06_15 (Increment E).

This is a CROSS-DOC-PRESENT counterfactual: Schedule 8812 lists NO standard deduction, but the vault's Form 1040 does ($23,625 for HoH). Resolver-OFF refuses (incidentally). This is the summary-scope-hole class WIDENED by the resolver; the fix is doc-scope recognition (a future arc), kill-switch MEMEX_AGENTS__FORM_FIELD_RESOLVER_ENABLED=false. Expected refusal_cf here = 0.5.

_baseline_2026_06_15.stack: Qwen3.5-4B-AWQ orchestrator + EmbeddingGemma-300M + bge-reranker-v2-m3 (cpu, device-pinned), co_residence_mode=manual
_baseline_2026_06_15.purpose: Held-out generality validation of the form-field resolvers (Increments A+D) on a form they were NOT built on (IRS Schedule 8812). SAFETY-framed.
_baseline_2026_06_15.findings: (1) MULTIPLY resolver (Increment D) SAFETY-GENERALITY CONFIRMED: the resolver returned NO ROUTE on Schedule 8812's LINE-REFERENCE multiply lines ('Multiply line 4 by $2,200' — content-poor desc, the single-digit disambiguator is tokenizer-dropped), i.e. it stayed CONSERVATIVE (no wrong-route, no fabrication); f8812-01/02 answered CORRECTLY ($2,200/$500) via the gates directly. Benefit-generality is idiom-specific BY DESIGN (the price of a precise deterministic resolver) — it helps INLINED-content multiply lines (W-4 style), not line-reference ones (Schedule 8812 style, the more common IRS form); those facts are gate-answerable anyway here, so not a weak spot. (2) BULLET resolver (Increment A) CROSS-DOC HOLE surfaced: f8812-07 (refusal_cf 1.0->0.5) — see its _note. The 'refusal_cf cannot regress by construction' claim was OVER-BROAD (holds for within-doc absent-value counterfactuals, NOT cross-doc-present ones). LATENT on shipped corpora (none contain a cross-doc-present counterfactual; main's measured gate is intact). Fix = doc-scope recognition (future arc).
_baseline_2026_06_15.caveat: Only ONE held-out form, a LINE-REFERENCE one, so safety-generality is confirmed on the hard case but the resolver FIRING on a held-out INLINED-content form is unmeasured (such forms are rare per the 1040-SR/1040-ES scan). Claim: safety-generality confirmed; benefit-generality idiom-specific by design.
